description: Item #77 (2026-10-07): free-tier-first providers for /ask only (scope router + answer). Tried in order; an entry whose api_key_env is unset is skipped; OpenAI (config/model-selection.json, priced from config/model-pricing.json) is always the last resort. Evaluation paths (TRACE capture, M6 baseline and judge, Gate A, pipeline) never read this file and stay on the selected OpenAI model.

providers.note: Free tier: $0 recorded (Groq's paid rate is listed at $0.075 in / $0.30 out per 1M). reasoning_effort low is required: without it the router's 60-token JSON call fails with 400 json_validate_failed (measured 2026-10-07).
Second Groq model: separate per-model free limits. Same reasoning_effort rule (measured 2026-10-07).

openrouter_example.note: Not active. To add OpenRouter, copy this object into providers (OpenAI stays the implied last resort), set model to a current ':free' id from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, and set OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Free models allow 50 requests/day without purchased credits (1,000/day with $10+). Check the account's privacy settings first: some providers may log or train on prompts.
